I am an applied microeconomist and final year PhD at the [Universite de Bourgogne](https://www.ube.fr/en/home/). My research mainly focuses on **competition economics**. I have had the opportunity to complete research stays at the University of Fribourg in Switzerland. I have also had the pleasure of contributing to the [Government Transparency Institute](https://www.govtransparency.eu/).

My work combines causal inference, machine learning, and network analysis to study collusive behavior. I conduct econometric analysis to support antitrust enforcement and policy design.

If you would like to grab a coffee, play chess, or chat, feel free to reach out!
